intro: Magus Tirth has locked a crucial spellbook inside his magically sealed strongbox, but he cannot recall the activation phrase to open it. To retrieve the tome, you must locate his missing apprentice somewhere around the Shimmering Flats racetrack and pry the forgotten words from him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can help you with the book, but first you have to help me!

The tome you seek is in my magically locked strongbox. To open it a special phrase must be uttered, and I can't remember the phrase! Normally my assistant helps me remember these things but he's nowhere to be found.

If you want my book, then find my apprentice! Ask around the race track—if you're lucky then someone has seen him. Either drag him back here, or at least get my magic phrase from him so we can open my box!

clips.title: Progress
paras: What are you waiting for? I need my magic phrase!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I had forgotten about that little curse I put on Johnson. I can't remember why I did it but I'm sure it served him right, the little ingrate!
